mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, is_correct, awarded_marks ) VALUES ( #{attemptId}, #{questionId}, #{selectedOption}, #{isCorrect}, #{awardedMarks} )

INSERT INTO student_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, is_correct, awarded_marks ) VALUES
( #{item.attemptId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.selectedOption}, #{item.isCorrect}, #{item.awardedMarks} )
mapper.select: SELECT answer_id, attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, is_correct, awarded_marks FROM student_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY answer_id ASC

SELECT q.question_id, q.question_text, sa.selected_option, q.correct_option, sa.is_correct, sa.awarded_marks, q.marks FROM student_answer sa LEFT JOIN question q ON sa.question_id = q.question_id WHERE sa.attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY q.question_id ASC
